# Images

Generate an image with an AI model.

**Library:** [Maitento](index.md#maitento), for apps. More in [Models and model keys](../../../concepts/models-and-keys.md).

| Call | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`ImageGenerate`](#imagegenerate) | Generates an image from a text prompt, saves it as a PNG file in a knowledge base, and returns the file's id. |

### ImageGenerate

Generates an image from a text prompt, saves it as a PNG file in a knowledge base, and returns the file's id. It waits for the image.

```c
string ImageGenerate(string model, string prompt, guid partitionId, string aspectRatio)
```

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `model` | `string` | The image model's name in the model catalogue, such as `openAi.gpt-image-1`, matched exactly. |
| `prompt` | `string` | What to draw. |
| `partitionId` | `guid` | The id of the knowledge base to save the image in. |
| `aspectRatio` | `string` | `Square` (1024 × 1024), `Landscape` (1536 × 1024) or `Portrait` (1024 × 1536), in any case. |

**Returns** `string`: The id of the new file in the knowledge base.

The image is drawn on the tenant's OpenAI model keys, tried in priority order; an app run started with its own credentials uses only those. When none of them produces an image, Maitento's own key is used, unless the tenant forbids Maitento's keys: then the call fails with `[api:model-keys:none-for-provider]` or `[api:model-keys:all-failed]`.

The file is named `wf-<app run id>-img-<file id>.png`. Like any image in a knowledge base, it is then described in words, in the background, so it can be searched.

Fails with "Invalid aspect ratio: '…'", "Model '…' not found", "Model '…' is not for image generation", and "AI model failed to generate image for unknown reason" when the provider refuses or fails.
